signals.title_en: Novartis's chief executive says AI will not cure cancer in five to ten years; expects about four years off drug development after a decade
signals.title_zh: 诺华首席执行官称 AI 不会在五到十年内治愈癌症；预计约十年后药物研发周期可缩短约四年
signals.so_what_en: A large pharma buyer of AI tools, whose chief executive also sits on Anthropic's board, puts the gain at a shorter timeline rather than cures, and says human and animal testing stays the bottleneck; it is a statement of expectation, not a result.
signals.so_what_zh: 一家大量采购 AI 工具的大型药企（其首席执行官同时是 Anthropic 董事）认为 AI 的收益是缩短研发周期而非治愈疾病，动物和人体试验仍是瓶颈；这是预期表态，不是试验结果。
signals.changes_view_en: Changes my view if Novartis or another large pharma reports a measured rise in clinical success rates for AI-assisted programmes.
signals.changes_view_zh: 如果诺华或其他大型药企公布 AI 辅助项目临床成功率的实测提升，我会改变看法。

signals.title_en: Lilly says TuneLab has passed 150 member companies and partner data has enlarged its training set by 30%
signals.title_zh: 礼来称 TuneLab 成员公司已超过 150 家，合作方数据使训练集扩大 30%
signals.so_what_en: Fourteen months after launch, Lilly's head of TuneLab reports about 700,000 partner data points and models for more than 100 endpoints, up from 16; the figures are Lilly's own, with no baseline for the 30% and no published benchmark of model accuracy.
signals.so_what_zh: 上线十四个月后，礼来 TuneLab 负责人称合作方已贡献约 70 万个数据点，模型可预测的指标从 16 个增至 100 多个；数字均为礼来自述，30% 的基数未说明，也没有公开的模型准确性基准。
signals.changes_view_en: Changes my view if Lilly publishes how much the partner data improved predictions, or if members start to leave.
signals.changes_view_zh: 如果礼来公布合作方数据使预测改善了多少，或成员开始退出，我会改变看法。

signals.title_en: Recursion's GTAEXS617 Phase 1/2 trial in head-and-neck and pancreatic cancer has closed recruitment
signals.title_zh: Recursion 的 GTAEXS617 头颈癌和胰腺癌 1/2 期试验已停止招募
signals.so_what_en: Enrolment is finished for this Exscientia-origin drug, so the next event is data; the registry gives January 2028 for primary completion.
signals.so_what_zh: 这款源自 Exscientia 的药物已完成入组，下一个事件是数据；登记库显示主要完成日期为 2028 年 1 月。
signals.changes_view_en: the trial is terminated, or results are posted earlier than the registry date.
signals.changes_view_zh: 试验被终止，或结果早于登记日期公布。

signals.title_en: Large drugmakers tell Reuters that AI has cut early discovery time by up to half; the count of AI-enabled drugs in trials has risen only slowly
signals.title_zh: 多家大型药企对路透社表示 AI 已将早期研发时间最多缩短一半；进入临床的 AI 相关药物数量仅缓慢增加
signals.so_what_en: Novo Nordisk says design-make-test cycles fell from about eight to three and from eight weeks to four each, and Novartis says the time to a drug candidate fell from three years to 18-24 months; these are the companies' own figures for the preclinical stage, and the same report counts 129 AI-enabled candidates in trials against about 117 eight months earlier.
signals.so_what_zh: 诺和诺德称“设计-合成-测试”循环从约八轮降至三轮，每轮从八周降至四周；诺华称得到候选药物的时间从三年降至 18 至 24 个月。这些是公司自述的临床前数据；同一报道统计进入临床的 AI 相关候选药物为 129 个，八个月前约为 117 个。
signals.changes_view_en: Changes my view if one of these companies shows that the faster programmes also succeed more often in human trials.
signals.changes_view_zh: 如果其中某家公司证明这些更快的项目在人体试验中成功率也更高，我会改变看法。

signals.title_en: Insilico's ISM9528 healthy-volunteer study is now listed as Early Phase 1, not Phase 1
signals.title_zh: 英矽智能 ISM9528 健康受试者研究的分期由一期改列为早期一期
signals.so_what_en: A relabelling in the registry of a very small exploratory study; it says nothing about whether the drug works.
signals.so_what_zh: 登记库对一项很小的探索性研究做了分期调整，并不说明药物是否有效。
signals.changes_view_en: the study is withdrawn or a full Phase 1 is registered.
signals.changes_view_zh: 该研究被撤回，或登记了完整的一期试验。

signals.title_en: Aulos Bioscience's AU-007 Phase 1/2 trial in solid tumours has closed recruitment
signals.title_zh: Aulos Bioscience 的 AU-007 实体瘤 1/2 期试验已停止招募
signals.so_what_en: Enrolment is finished for this computationally designed antibody from a private company; the registry gives February 2027 for primary completion.
signals.so_what_zh: 这款由未上市公司通过计算设计的抗体已完成入组；登记库显示主要完成日期为 2027 年 2 月。
signals.changes_view_en: results are posted or the trial is terminated.
signals.changes_view_zh: 公布结果或试验被终止。

signals.title_en: Merck and Isomorphic Labs sign a research collaboration; amounts not disclosed
signals.title_zh: 默沙东与 Isomorphic Labs 签署研究合作，金额未披露
signals.so_what_en: Another large drugmaker pays for Isomorphic's platform, but without the upfront figure the deal cannot be sized or compared with earlier ones.
signals.so_what_zh: 又一家大型药企为 Isomorphic 的平台付费，但未披露首付款，无法衡量规模，也无法与此前的交易比较。
signals.changes_view_en: the upfront payment is disclosed, in a filing or by either company.
signals.changes_view_zh: 任何一方或监管文件披露首付款金额。

signals.title_en: Recursion says the FDA agreed the design of a registrational Phase 3 trial for REC-4881
signals.title_zh: Recursion 称 FDA 已同意 REC-4881 注册性三期试验的设计
signals.so_what_en: A randomised, placebo-controlled trial of about 200 patients, due to start in the second half of 2027, would be one of the first late-stage tests of a drug from an AI drug company; the supporting data so far are from an uncontrolled Phase 1b/2 study.
signals.so_what_zh: 这项约 200 名患者的随机、安慰剂对照试验计划于 2027 年下半年启动，将是 AI 制药公司药物最早的后期检验之一；目前的支持数据来自无对照的 1b/2 期研究。
signals.changes_view_en: the trial start slips past 2027, or the FDA's position on the endpoint changes.
signals.changes_view_zh: 试验启动推迟到 2027 年之后，或 FDA 对终点的立场发生变化。

signals.title_en: Isomorphic Labs raises US$5B in a Series C led by Greenoaks and Sequoia
signals.title_zh: Isomorphic Labs 完成 50 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 Greenoaks 和红杉领投
signals.so_what_en: US$5B a few months after a US$2.1B round, with no drug yet in human trials: a reading of private appetite and a comparable for listed AI drug platforms, not evidence that the science works.
signals.so_what_zh: 在 21 亿美元融资数月之后再融 50 亿美元，而尚无药物进入人体试验：这反映的是私募市场的热度，可作为上市 AI 药物平台的可比参照，并不证明科学有效。
signals.changes_view_en: Isomorphic or a partner takes one of its candidates into a human trial.
signals.changes_view_zh: Isomorphic 或其合作方将其候选药物推进人体试验。

signals.title_en: AstraZeneca commits US$200M to Tempus AI over five years in a renewed data and AI agreement
signals.title_zh: 阿斯利康续签与 Tempus AI 的数据和 AI 协议，五年承诺支付 2 亿美元
signals.so_what_en: A large drugmaker has bound itself to at least US$32M a year through 2031 for Tempus's data and AI tools, and owes any shortfall if it ends the agreement early: committed spending, which says nothing about whether AI improves drug development.
signals.so_what_zh: 一家大型药企承诺在 2031 年前每年至少向 Tempus 支付 3200 万美元，用于其数据和 AI 工具，若提前终止须补足差额：这是已承诺的支出，并不说明 AI 是否改善了药物研发。
signals.changes_view_en: AstraZeneca ends the agreement early, or Tempus's filings show spending running below the US$40M annual target.
signals.changes_view_zh: 阿斯利康提前终止协议，或 Tempus 的文件显示实际支出低于每年 4000 万美元的目标。

signals.title_en: OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio, whose software agents track drug development programmes; price not disclosed
signals.title_zh: OpenAI 收购 Orchestra Bio，其软件智能体用于跟踪药物开发项目；价格未披露
signals.so_what_en: The team and product join OpenAI's Rosalind life-sciences suite, moving it from research questions into the running of drug programmes; this is a purchase from 20 October that reappeared in the news search, with no amount and no result attached.
signals.so_what_zh: 该团队和产品并入 OpenAI 的 Rosalind 生命科学套件，使其从科研问答延伸到药物项目的日常管理；这是 10 月 20 日的收购，今天在新闻搜索中再次出现，没有金额，也没有任何结果。
signals.changes_view_en: Changes my view if a drugmaker reports a measured cut in development time from using it.
signals.changes_view_zh: 如果有药企公布使用它后研发时间的实测缩短，我会改变看法。

profile.name: Anthropic
profile.what_en: Anthropic builds the Claude family of AI models and sells access to them to businesses, developers and individuals. It listed on Nasdaq on 19 November 2026, raising $81.3 billion; it reported a large net loss for the first nine months of 2026.
profile.what_zh: Anthropic 开发 Claude 系列 AI 模型，并向企业、开发者和个人出售使用权。公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在纳斯达克上市，募资 813 亿美元；2026 年前九个月录得大额净亏损。
profile.ai_en: Life sciences is a small part of the business: Claude for Life Sciences (October 2025), the Claude Science workbench (June 2026), the reported purchase of Coefficient Bio and the acquisition of Mithril Medicine in 2026; Novo Nordisk and Sanofi are among its users.
profile.ai_zh: 生命科学只占业务的一小部分：2025 年 10 月推出 Claude for Life Sciences，2026 年 6 月推出科研工作台 Claude Science；2026 年据报道收购 Coefficient Bio，并收购 Mithril Medicine；用户包括诺和诺德、赛诺菲。

profile.name: NVIDIA
profile.what_en: NVIDIA designs the graphics processors (GPUs) and related systems and software on which most AI models are trained and run. Most of its revenue comes from selling these to data-centre operators.
profile.what_zh: 英伟达设计图形处理器（GPU）及配套系统和软件，多数 AI 模型在其上训练和运行。公司大部分收入来自向数据中心运营方销售这些产品。
profile.ai_en: Life sciences is a small part of the business: BioNeMo is its software platform for biology and drug-discovery models, and in January 2026 it agreed a joint lab with Eli Lilly, with up to $1 billion to be invested over five years.
profile.ai_zh: 生命科学只占业务的一小部分：BioNeMo 是其面向生物学和药物发现模型的软件平台；2026 年 1 月与礼来约定共建实验室，五年内最高投入 10 亿美元。

source.title: NVIDIA and Lilly Announce Co-Innovation AI Lab to Reinvent Drug Discovery in the Age of AI

profile.name: Eli Lilly
profile.what_en: Eli Lilly discovers, makes and sells prescription medicines. Its products include Mounjaro and Zepbound for diabetes and obesity, Verzenio for breast cancer and Kisunla for Alzheimer's disease; revenue comes from selling them.
profile.what_zh: 礼来研发、生产并销售处方药，产品包括治疗糖尿病和肥胖的 Mounjaro 和 Zepbound、治疗乳腺癌的 Verzenio 以及治疗阿尔茨海默病的 Kisunla；收入来自药品销售。
profile.ai_en: AI is a small part of the business: it runs an NVIDIA-built supercomputer with 1,016 GPUs, shares its models with biotechs through TuneLab, agreed a joint lab with NVIDIA (up to $1 billion over five years), and has deals with Isomorphic Labs and Insilico.
profile.ai_zh: AI 只占业务的一小部分：礼来拥有一台英伟达建造、配备 1016 块 GPU 的超级计算机，通过 TuneLab 向生物科技公司开放模型，与英伟达约定共建实验室（五年内最高 10 亿美元），并与 Isomorphic Labs、英矽智能签有合作。

source.title: Now Live: Lilly AI Factory for Pharmaceutical Discovery and Development

profile.name: Novo Nordisk
profile.what_en: Novo Nordisk makes and sells medicines for diabetes and obesity, including Wegovy, as well as insulin and treatments for rare blood and hormone disorders. Its revenue comes from selling them.
profile.what_zh: 诺和诺德生产并销售糖尿病和肥胖药物（包括 Wegovy），以及胰岛素和罕见血液病、内分泌疾病药物；收入来自药品销售。
profile.ai_en: AI is a small part of the business: in September 2026 it agreed to test Anthropic's Claude Science on selected research problems, and since 2025 it has worked with NVIDIA using Denmark's Gefion supercomputer.
profile.ai_zh: AI 只占业务的一小部分：2026 年 9 月公司同意在选定的研究课题上试用 Anthropic 的 Claude Science；自 2025 年起与英伟达合作，使用丹麦的 Gefion 超级计算机。

source.title: Novo Nordisk partners with Anthropic to apply AI to drug discovery and research

profile.name: Recursion
profile.what_en: Recursion uses AI and automated lab experiments to find and develop its own drugs. It has no product on sale; revenue comes mainly from research collaborations with drug makers such as Sanofi and Roche/Genentech.
profile.what_zh: Recursion 用 AI 和自动化实验室寻找并开发自有药物。公司尚无产品上市，收入主要来自与赛诺菲、罗氏/基因泰克等药企的研发合作。
profile.ai_en: Its platform, Recursion OS, covers drug discovery through development; it merged with the UK AI drug designer Exscientia in November 2024.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台 Recursion OS 覆盖从药物发现到开发的全过程；2024 年 11 月与英国 AI 药物设计公司 Exscientia 合并。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: REC-4881 for familial adenomatous polyposis (inherited bowel polyps) is in a Phase 1b/2 trial. On 18 November 2026 Recursion said the FDA agreed its Phase 3 design (about 200 patients); start planned for second-half 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：REC-4881 用于家族性腺瘤性息肉病（一种导致肠道多发息肉的遗传病），处于 1b/2 期试验。公司 2026 年 11 月 18 日称 FDA 已同意三期试验设计（约 200 名患者），计划 2027 年下半年启动。

source.title: Recursion Announces Alignment with FDA on Registrational Phase 3 Trial Design for REC-4881 in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis

profile.name: Insilico Medicine
profile.what_en: Insilico Medicine designs drug candidates with its own AI software and develops them itself or licenses them to larger drug makers. It reported a net profit of about $35.5 million for the first half of 2026.
profile.what_zh: 英矽智能用自研 AI 软件设计候选药物，自行开发或授权给大型药企。公司披露 2026 年上半年净利润约 0.36 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Its platform is called Pharma.AI; in March 2026 it signed a collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.75 billion including milestones.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台名为 Pharma.AI；2026 年 3 月与礼来签署合作协议，含里程碑付款最高 27.5 亿美元。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: rentosertib (INS018_055), a pill for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (scarring of the lungs), is in a Phase 3 trial in China that started in July 2026 and plans to enrol 320 patients.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：rentosertib（INS018_055）是治疗特发性肺纤维化（肺部瘢痕化）的口服药，三期试验已于 2026 年 7 月在中国启动，计划入组 320 名患者。

source.title: Insilico Initiates Phase III Clinical Trial for Rentosertib, Its AI-Empowered TNIK Inhibitor for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis

profile.name: Generate Biomedicines
profile.what_en: Generate Biomedicines designs protein drugs, mainly antibodies, with machine-learning models and develops them itself. It has no product on sale; revenue comes from research programmes with Amgen and Novartis.
profile.what_zh: Generate Biomedicines 用机器学习模型设计蛋白质药物（主要是抗体）并自行开发。公司尚无产品上市，收入来自与安进、诺华的研究项目。
profile.ai_en: It calls its approach generative biology: models propose new protein sequences that its labs then test; partners include Novartis, Amgen and, since October 2026, Zealand Pharma.
profile.ai_zh: 公司称其方法为“生成式生物学”：由模型提出新的蛋白质序列，再由实验室验证；合作方包括诺华、安进，以及 2026 年 10 月起的 Zealand Pharma。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: GB-0895, an antibody against TSLP designed for dosing twice a year, is in two global Phase 3 trials (SOLAIRIA-1 and SOLAIRIA-2) in severe asthma.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：GB-0895 是一种抗 TSLP 抗体，设计为每年给药两次，正在重度哮喘中进行两项全球三期试验（SOLAIRIA-1 和 SOLAIRIA-2）。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

profile.name: Schrödinger
profile.what_en: Schrödinger sells software that simulates how molecules behave, used by drug and materials companies. It also earns fees, milestones and royalties from drug discovery collaborations and holds stakes in companies it helped start.
profile.what_zh: 薛定谔销售模拟分子行为的软件，客户为药企和材料企业；公司还从药物发现合作中获得服务费、里程碑付款和特许权使用费，并持有其参与创办公司的股权。
profile.ai_en: Its platform combines physics-based simulation with machine learning; partners include Novartis, and it co-invented zasocitinib, now owned by Takeda and under FDA review.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台把基于物理的模拟与机器学习结合；合作方包括诺华，公司还是 zasocitinib 的共同发明方，该药现归武田所有，正在接受 FDA 审评。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: SGR-1505, a MALT1 inhibitor for B-cell blood cancers, is in Phase 1; updated data are due at a haematology meeting in December 2026.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：SGR-1505 是一种 MALT1 抑制剂，用于 B 细胞血液肿瘤，处于一期试验；更新数据将于 2026 年 12 月在血液学会议上公布。

source.title: Schrödinger Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

profile.name: Absci
profile.what_en: Absci designs antibody drugs with generative AI models and tests them in its own labs. It develops some itself and designs others for partners; revenue is small ($0.3 million in the third quarter of 2026).
profile.what_zh: Absci 用生成式 AI 模型设计抗体药物，并在自有实验室验证；部分自行开发，部分为合作方设计。收入规模很小（2026 年第三季度为 30 万美元）。
profile.ai_en: Its Integrated Drug Creation platform pairs AI models with a synthetic-biology lab that generates the training data.
profile.ai_zh: 其 Integrated Drug Creation 平台把 AI 模型与产生训练数据的合成生物学实验室结合。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: ABS-201, an antibody for pattern hair loss, is in a Phase 1/2a trial; 13-week interim data are expected in December 2026 and full data in early 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：ABS-201 是治疗雄激素性脱发的抗体，处于 1/2a 期试验；预计 2026 年 12 月公布 13 周中期数据，2027 年初公布完整数据。

source.title: Absci Reports Business Updates and Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

profile.name: AbCellera
profile.what_en: AbCellera discovers antibody drugs. It began by finding antibodies for partners in return for research fees and royalties, and now also develops its own; third-quarter 2026 revenue was $10.6 million, mostly research fees.
profile.what_zh: AbCellera 从事抗体药物发现。公司最初为合作方寻找抗体并收取研究费用和特许权使用费，现在也开发自有药物；2026 年第三季度收入 1060 万美元，主要为研究费用。
profile.ai_en: Its link to AI is indirect: it describes a discovery engine built on single-cell screening and high-throughput testing, and its November 2026 results release does not mention AI.
profile.ai_zh: 它与 AI 的关联是间接的：公司介绍的发现平台以单细胞筛选和高通量检测为基础，2026 年 11 月的业绩公告未提及 AI。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: ABCL635, an injected antibody for menopausal hot flashes, reported positive top-line Phase 2 results; the company expects to start late-stage trials in 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：ABCL635 是治疗更年期潮热的注射用抗体，已公布积极的二期顶线结果；公司预计 2027 年启动后期试验。

source.title: AbCellera Reports Q3 2026 Business Results

profile.name: Relay Therapeutics
profile.what_en: Relay Therapeutics develops pills for cancer and genetic diseases. It sells no product itself; its income is licence revenue, and the first drug from its platform, lirafugratinib, was approved in the US in 2026 and is sold by licensee Elevar Therapeutics.
profile.what_zh: Relay Therapeutics 开发治疗癌症和遗传病的口服药。公司自身没有在售产品，收入为授权收入；其平台产出的首个药物 lirafugratinib 于 2026 年在美国获批，由被授权方 Elevar Therapeutics 销售。
profile.ai_en: Its Dynamo platform combines computer simulation of how proteins move with lab experiments to design small-molecule drugs.
profile.ai_zh: 其 Dynamo 平台把蛋白质运动的计算机模拟与实验结合，用于设计小分子药物。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: zovegalisib (RLY-2608) is in a Phase 3 trial (ReDiscover-2) in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer with a PI3Kα mutation, compared against capivasertib, both given with fulvestrant.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：zovegalisib（RLY-2608）正在携带 PI3Kα 突变的 HR+/HER2- 转移性乳腺癌中进行三期试验（ReDiscover-2），与 capivasertib 对照，两者均联用氟维司群。

source.title: Relay Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Updates

profile.name: Iambic Therapeutics
profile.what_en: Iambic Therapeutics designs small-molecule cancer drugs with AI and develops them itself; it also has discovery partnerships with drug makers including Takeda, AbbVie, Jazz and Revolution Medicines. It raised $150 million in its October 2026 listing.
profile.what_zh: Iambic Therapeutics 用 AI 设计小分子抗癌药并自行开发，同时与武田、艾伯维、Jazz、Revolution Medicines 等药企开展药物发现合作。公司 2026 年 10 月上市，募资 1.5 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Its AI models include Enchant, which predicts how a drug candidate will behave in the body, and NeuralPLexer, which predicts molecular structures.
profile.ai_zh: 其 AI 模型包括预测候选药物体内表现的 Enchant 和预测分子结构的 NeuralPLexer。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: IAM1363, a pill that blocks HER2 for HER2-altered solid tumours including breast and lung cancers, is in a Phase 1/1b trial; a registrational trial could start as soon as 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：IAM1363 是一种口服 HER2 抑制剂，用于乳腺癌、肺癌等 HER2 异常实体瘤，处于 1/1b 期试验；注册性试验最早可能于 2027 年启动。

source.title: Iambic, an AI drug discovery specialist, banks $150M in an IPO

profile.name: Tempus AI
profile.what_en: Tempus sells genomic and other laboratory tests, mainly for cancer, and licenses the resulting de-identified patient data and models to drug makers. Third-quarter 2026 revenue was $411.5 million: $303.5 million from diagnostics and $108.1 million from data and applications.
profile.what_zh: Tempus 销售基因组等实验室检测（主要用于癌症），并把由此形成的去标识化患者数据和模型授权给药企。2026 年第三季度收入 4.115 亿美元，其中诊断 3.035 亿美元，数据与应用 1.081 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Drug makers use its data and models in R&D; in October 2026 Bristol Myers Squibb agreed to license oncology data and models for up to $137.5 million over five years.
profile.ai_zh: 药企在研发中使用其数据和模型；2026 年 10 月，百时美施贵宝同意在五年内以最高 1.375 亿美元授权使用其肿瘤数据和模型。

source.title: Tempus Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

profile.name: XtalPi
profile.what_en: XtalPi sells drug-discovery and materials-research services that combine AI, physics-based calculation and robot-run laboratories. First-half 2026 revenue was RMB 393.6 million, about half from drug discovery work and half from automated-lab and AI solutions.
profile.what_zh: 晶泰科技提供结合 AI、物理计算和机器人实验室的药物发现与材料研发服务。2026 年上半年收入 3.936 亿元人民币，药物发现服务与自动化实验室及 AI 解决方案约各占一半。
profile.ai_en: It designs drug candidates for partners rather than running its own trials; its largest deal, with DoveTree in 2025, is worth up to about $6 billion in milestones, of which $51 million was paid first.
profile.ai_zh: 公司为合作方设计候选药物，而不是自己开展临床试验；最大一笔合作是 2025 年与 DoveTree 的协议，含里程碑付款最高约 60 亿美元，首笔已付 0.51 亿美元。

source.publisher: XtalPi (press release via Thailand Business News)
source.title: XtalPi Holdings Announces 2026 Interim Results

profile.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
profile.what_en: Thermo Fisher sells laboratory instruments, chemicals and supplies, and runs clinical trials (PPD) and drug manufacturing (Patheon) for drug makers. Annual revenue is over $40 billion.
profile.what_zh: 赛默飞销售实验室仪器、试剂和耗材，并为药企提供临床试验（PPD）和药品生产（Patheon）服务。年收入超过 400 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: AI is a small part of the business: it is building AI into instruments and trial services, with OpenAI (announced October 2025, starting in clinical trials) and with NVIDIA (January 2026, for laboratory instruments and automation).
profile.ai_zh: AI 只占业务的一小部分：公司正把 AI 嵌入仪器和临床试验服务，合作方包括 OpenAI（2025 年 10 月宣布，先用于临床试验）和英伟达（2026 年 1 月，用于实验室仪器和自动化）。

source.title: Artificial Intelligence

profile.name: Lantern Pharma
profile.what_en: Lantern Pharma is a small cancer-drug developer that uses AI to pick which patients and cancers its drugs may suit. It reported no revenue in 2026 to date; its chief executive resigned on 15 November 2026 and the finance chief is interim CEO.
profile.what_zh: Lantern Pharma 是一家小型抗癌药开发公司，用 AI 判断其药物可能适合哪些患者和癌种。公司 2026 年至今没有收入；首席执行官已于 2026 年 11 月 15 日辞职，由首席财务官暂代。
profile.ai_en: Its AI platform, RADR, is described as using more than 200 billion cancer-related data points and over 200 algorithms.
profile.ai_zh: 其 AI 平台 RADR 据称使用超过 2000 亿个癌症相关数据点和 200 多种算法。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: LP-300 is in a Phase 2 trial (HARMONIC) in lung cancer patients who have never smoked, given with chemotherapy; the second part of the trial opened in Taiwan in 2026.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：LP-300 正在从不吸烟的肺癌患者中进行二期试验（HARMONIC），与化疗联用；试验第二部分已于 2026 年在台湾启动。

source.title: Lantern Pharma Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates

profile.name: Evaxion
profile.what_en: Evaxion is a small Danish company that uses AI to design vaccines, now mainly against cancer. It has no product on sale and recorded no revenue in the third quarter of 2026; earlier revenue came from licensing a vaccine candidate to MSD.
profile.what_zh: Evaxion 是一家丹麦小型公司，用 AI 设计疫苗，目前以癌症疫苗为主。公司没有在售产品，2026 年第三季度没有收入；此前的收入来自向默沙东授权一款候选疫苗。
profile.ai_en: Its platform, AI-Immunology, is used to pick vaccine targets and design candidates; in November 2026 it said it would focus on cancer and pursue infectious-disease work only with partner funding.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台 AI-Immunology 用于挑选疫苗靶点和设计候选产品；2026 年 11 月公司表示将聚焦癌症，传染病项目仅在合作方出资时推进。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: EVX-01, a cancer vaccine made individually for each patient, has completed a Phase 2 trial in advanced melanoma (with pembrolizumab); the company is seeking partners to take it further.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：EVX-01 是为每位患者单独制备的癌症疫苗，已完成晚期黑色素瘤二期试验（联用帕博利珠单抗）；公司正在寻找合作方继续推进。

source.title: Evaxion announces strategy and business update and third quarter 2026 financial results

profile.name: BioAge Labs
profile.what_en: BioAge develops drugs for heart and metabolic diseases by studying the biology of human ageing. It has no product on sale and funds itself from investors and research collaborations with Novartis and Lilly.
profile.what_zh: BioAge 通过研究人类衰老的生物学机制，开发心血管和代谢疾病药物。公司没有在售产品，资金来自投资者以及与诺华、礼来的研究合作。
profile.ai_en: Its target-discovery platform analyses human longevity data, and it has an AI-driven drug discovery collaboration with Deep Origin; the company does not describe itself mainly as an AI company.
profile.ai_zh: 其靶点发现平台分析人类长寿数据，并与 Deep Origin 开展 AI 驱动的药物发现合作；公司并不主要以 AI 公司自居。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: BGE-102, a pill that blocks NLRP3 (a driver of inflammation), is in two Phase 2 trials: obesity with cardiovascular risk (data expected in late 2026) and diabetic macular edema. An earlier drug, azelaprag, was stopped over liver findings.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：BGE-102 是一种口服 NLRP3（炎症驱动因子）抑制剂，正在进行两项二期试验：伴心血管风险的肥胖（预计 2026 年第四季度出数据）和糖尿病黄斑水肿。此前的药物 azelaprag 因肝脏指标异常而停止。

source.title: BioAge Labs Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates

profile.name: Structure Therapeutics

drugs.ai_role_zh: HotSpot 称 HST-1011“得益于 HotSpot 专有的 Smart Allostery 平台”，该平台用计算方法和人工智能数据挖掘寻找 CBL-B 等蛋白上的调控口袋（“热点”），并发现与之结合的小分子。

source.title: HotSpot Therapeutics Announces FDA Clearance of IND Application for HST-1011, an Investigational Small Molecule Allosteric Inhibitor of CBL-B

drugs.ai_role_en: Enveda calls ENV-294 'the first drug candidate to advance to clinical trials based off of a molecule discovered in nature using AI': its platform (mass spectrometry plus machine learning) found the natural molecule, which chemists then adapted.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Enveda 称 ENV-294 是“首个基于利用人工智能在自然界中发现的分子而进入临床试验的候选药物”：其平台（质谱加机器学习）找到了该天然分子，再由化学家加以改造。

source.title: Enveda Announces First Candidate Discovered From Nature Using AI Advances to Clinical Trials

drugs.note: The AI found the starting natural product; ENV-294 itself is a derivative made by medicinal chemistry, not an AI-designed structure.

drugs.ai_role_en: BigHat says the CDH17-directed antibody-drug conjugate BHB810 'was engineered using BigHat's AI-powered antibody design platform'; it is the company's first AI-generated design in human studies.
drugs.ai_role_zh: BigHat 称靶向 CDH17 的抗体偶联药物 BHB810“是利用 BigHat 的人工智能抗体设计平台设计的”；这是该公司首个进入人体研究的人工智能生成设计。

source.publisher: BigHat Biosciences press release (Drug Development & Delivery)
source.title: Company's First AI-Generated Design Goes Into Human Studies

drugs.note: The claim covers the antibody; the release does not say where the payload and linker come from.

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says its PandaOmics engine proposed TNIK as a novel fibrosis target and its Chemistry42 engine generated the inhibitor, so both target and molecule came from its platform.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，其 PandaOmics 引擎提出 TNIK 这一新的纤维化靶点，其 Chemistry42 引擎生成了该抑制剂，即靶点和分子均出自自有平台。

source.title: TNIK Inhibitor: Treating Fibrotic diseases of the Lung and Kidney

drugs.note: Also known as ISM001-055. The pipeline page uses the name rentosertib only; the link to INS018_055 is from Insilico's Nature Biotechnology / Nature Medicine papers (seen in search summaries, not opened).

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says this MAT2A inhibitor was designed with its generative chemistry engine Chemistry42 (ligand-based AI design); the target itself is a known one, not claimed as AI-found.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，这一 MAT2A 抑制剂由其生成式化学引擎 Chemistry42 设计（基于配体的 AI 设计）；靶点为已知靶点，公司未称由 AI 发现。

source.title: Insilico Medicine announces first patient dosed with ISM3412 in a global multicenter trial

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says this gut-restricted PHD inhibitor was developed with its Pharma.AI platform, nominated after about 115 compounds were made and screened in AI workflows assisted by Chemistry42.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，这一肠道限制性 PHD 抑制剂由其 Pharma.AI 平台开发，在 Chemistry42 辅助的 AI 流程中合成并筛选约 115 个化合物后确定为候选药物。

source.title: Insilico Medicine release on garutadustat (ISM5411) Phase IIa first patient dosing

drugs.note: USAN name garutadustat. Source title is paraphrased; the URL is the release opened.

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says its Chemistry42 engine produced the lead ENPP1 inhibitor within three months, which its medicinal chemists then optimised; the release does not say AI chose the target.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，其 Chemistry42 引擎在三个月内得到 ENPP1 抑制剂先导化合物，随后由公司药物化学家优化；新闻稿未称靶点由 AI 选出。

source.title: Insilico Medicine announces FDA IND clearance for ISM5939, an oral ENPP1 inhibitor for solid tumors

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says this pan-TEAD inhibitor was developed from its generative chemistry engine Chemistry42, guided by its structure-based design strategy.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，这一泛 TEAD 抑制剂出自其生成式化学引擎 Chemistry42，并以其基于结构的设计策略为指导。

source.title: Insilico Medicine release on first patient dosed with ISM6331 (pan-TEAD inhibitor)

drugs.note: Source title is paraphrased; the URL is the release opened.

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico and Fosun Pharma say they jointly proposed the target hypothesis (QPCTL) and designed the compound using Insilico's Pharma.AI platform; the drug is co-developed with Fosun Pharma.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能与复星医药称，双方利用英矽智能的 Pharma.AI 平台共同提出靶点假设（QPCTL）并设计了该化合物；该药由双方共同开发。

source.title: Insilico Medicine and Fosun Pharma release on first patient dosed with QPCTL inhibitor ISM8207

drugs.note: Partner: Fosun Pharma (collaboration since January 2022). A search summary of Insilico's QPCTL page adds that PandaOmics identified QPCTL and generative chemistry made the molecule (snippet only). The release spells the code both ISM8207 and ISM8027.

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico calls this brain-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor an AI-generated molecule that it optimised with Chemistry42; the target is a known one.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，这一可入脑的 NLRP3 抑制剂是 AI 生成的分子，并用 Chemistry42 优化；靶点为已知靶点。

source.title: Insilico completes first-in-human dosing in Phase I clinical study of AI-driven NLRP3 inhibitor ISM8969

drugs.note: Co-developed with Hygtia Therapeutics, which holds 50% of global rights; Insilico designed the molecule and leads Phase I, so counted as platform rather than partner.

drugs.ai_role_en: Insilico says PandaOmics identified the undisclosed pain target ('Target Z') and Chemistry42 generated improved compounds starting from one the team had already made, leading to ISM9528.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 英矽智能称，PandaOmics 找出了未披露的疼痛靶点（“Target Z”），Chemistry42 在团队已有的一个化合物基础上生成了改进分子，最终得到 ISM9528。

source.publisher: PR Newswire Asia (Insilico Medicine press release)
source.title: Targeting the $100 Billion Market: Insilico Medicine Nominates AI-driven Novel PCC ISM9528 for Pain Management

drugs.note: Release of 2026-07-22 planned clinical trials for 2027, yet the registry (NCT07932041, sponsor InSilico Medicine Hong Kong) already lists an Early Phase 1 single-participant study as recruiting. Target not disclosed.

drugs.ai_role_en: Not a Healx discovery: gaboxadol is an old compound that Ovid Therapeutics developed as OV101, and Healx took an exclusive option to license it from Ovid in February 2022 to combine with its own Fragile X picks.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 并非 Healx 发现：加波沙朵是一个老化合物，Ovid Therapeutics 曾以 OV101 开发；Healx 于 2022 年 2 月从 Ovid 取得独家许可选择权，用于与自己挑选的脆性 X 综合征药物联用。

source.title: Ovid Therapeutics Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2023 (Healx License and Option Agreement)

drugs.note: The two OV101 Angelman trials (NCT02996305, NCT03882918; the Phase 3 failed in 2020) were run by Ovid before the deal; the registry now lists 'Healx AI' as their sponsor, which is why they are attributed to Healx. No page opened says Healx's AI selected gaboxadol. The Healx Fragile X combination trial (NCT04823052) was withdrawn.

drugs.ai_role_en: Repurposed: Healx says HLX-0201, a drug originally approved as a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory, was identified for Fragile X by its omic-based drug-matching methods (its AI platform Healnet); the AI chose the drug, it did not design it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 老药新用：Healx 称 HLX-0201 原为获批的非甾体抗炎药，由其基于组学的药物匹配方法（AI 平台 Healnet）识别为脆性 X 综合征的潜在疗法；AI 是选药而非设计分子。

source.title: Healx receives IND and Orphan Drug Designation for fragile X clinical trial

drugs.note: The release does not name sulindac; the trial registry (NCT04823052) gives HLX-0201 = sulindac. Trial withdrawn before enrolment.

drugs.ai_role_en: Repurposed: Healx says its AI platform discovered HLX-1502 for NF1, and its CEO told TechCrunch it is a reformulated existing drug developed for something else that never launched in the US; the AI matched a known compound to the disease.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 老药新用：Healx 称其 AI 平台为 1 型神经纤维瘤病发现了 HLX-1502；其首席执行官对 TechCrunch 表示，这是一个为其他用途开发、从未在美国上市的已有药物的新剂型；AI 是把已知化合物与疾病匹配。

source.title: Healx, an AI-enabled drug discovery platform for rare diseases, raises $47M

drugs.note: Healx has not disclosed which compound HLX-1502 is. GEN (genengnews.com, opened) quotes only 'HLX-1502 was discovered using Healx's AI platform' without saying it is an existing drug.

drugs.ai_role_en: Generate says GB-0895 was designed using its Generate Platform, which optimised affinity and developability starting from a reference anti-TSLP antibody in two generation cycles; a YTE half-life extension was added.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Generate 称 GB-0895 由其 Generate Platform 设计：平台以一个参照抗 TSLP 抗体为起点，经两轮生成优化了亲和力和可开发性，并加入 YTE 半衰期延长技术。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. prospectus (Rule 424(b)(4))

drugs.note: An optimisation of an existing reference antibody, not a de novo design; the prospectus does not name the reference (a search summary says it was Amgen's tezepelumab: snippet only).

drugs.ai_role_en: Generate says its platform's cross-reactive binding, viral neutralisation and affinity optimisation modules engineered GB-0669, which it calls the first AI-generated SARS-CoV-2 neutralising antibody against the S2 domain.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Generate 称其平台的交叉反应结合、病毒中和和亲和力优化模块设计了 GB-0669，并称其为首个针对 S2 结构域的 AI 生成新冠病毒中和抗体。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. prospectus (Rule 424(b)(4))

drugs.note: Development paused after Phase 1 for commercial reasons, per the prospectus.

drugs.ai_role_en: Generate says its platform's affinity optimisation module generated GB-7624, an anti-IL-13 antibody with about 40-fold tighter binding than lebrikizumab.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Generate 称其平台的亲和力优化模块生成了抗 IL-13 抗体 GB-7624，其结合力比来瑞组单抗强约 40 倍。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. prospectus (Rule 424(b)(4))

drugs.ai_role_en: Generate says it applied its platform's binding-optimisation technology to make GB-4362, an antibody that binds free MMAE (the toxic payload shed by antibody-drug conjugates), and calls it a computationally generated candidate.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Generate 称其用平台的结合优化技术制成 GB-4362，这是一种结合游离 MMAE（抗体偶联药物释放的毒性载荷）的抗体，并称其为计算生成的候选药物。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. prospectus (Rule 424(b)(4))

drugs.ai_role_en: Ensem says ETX-636, an allosteric PI3K-alpha inhibitor and degrader, was designed using its Kinetic Ensemble platform to fit a specific allosteric binding site.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Ensem 称变构 PI3Kα 抑制剂兼降解剂 ETX-636 是用其 Kinetic Ensemble 平台设计的，以契合一个特定的变构结合位点。

source.title: Ensem Therapeutics Announces ETX-636 Granted Fast Track Designation by the FDA for Advanced Breast Cancer

drugs.note: Two registry arms include fulvestrant (a marketed drug, origin other) as the combination partner. That Kinetic Ensemble combines AI/ML with computational and experimental tools is from a search summary of Ensem releases, not from the opened page (snippet).

drugs.ai_role_en: Ensem says ETX-929, an oral pan-KRAS inhibitor, was designed leveraging its proprietary Kinetic Ensemble platform.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Ensem 称口服泛 KRAS 抑制剂 ETX-929 是借助其自有 Kinetic Ensemble 平台设计的。

source.title: Ensem Therapeutics Highlights Novel, Potent, and Selective Oral pan-KRAS and WRN Inhibitors with Best-in-Class Potential

drugs.note: One registry arm includes cetuximab (a marketed drug, origin other). The original Business Wire page returned HTTP 403; this is a repost of the same release.

drugs.ai_role_en: MindRank says this oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist was developed using its Molecule Pro AI platform and calls it one of the first AI-designed molecules to reach Phase III; the target is a well-known one.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 德睿智药称，这一口服小分子 GLP-1 受体激动剂由其 Molecule Pro AI 平台开发，并称其为最早进入 III 期的 AI 设计分子之一；靶点为众所周知的已知靶点。

source.title: MindRank Initiates Phase III MOBILE Trial of MDR-001, Oral GLP-1RA Small Molecule

drugs.note: Company press release carried by a newswire repost; 'first AI-designed molecule in Phase III' is the company's own claim.

drugs.ai_role_en: Repurposed: OC514 is a fixed combination of two existing drugs that Oncocross's RAPTOR AI platform selected for a new indication (muscle loss / cancer cachexia); the AI chose the pair, it did not design a molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 老药新用：OC514 是两种已有药物的复方，由 Oncocross 的 RAPTOR AI 平台筛选用于新适应症（肌肉减少、癌症恶病质）；AI 是选药配对，而非设计分子。

source.title: 온코크로스, 'AI' 근감소증 후보물질 "호주 1상 시작"

drugs.note: Korean trade article of 2022-02-23 ('기존의 다른 두 약물을 혼합해 새로운 적응증의 약물로 개발된 복합제'). The two ingredients are not disclosed. Korean rights were licensed to Korea Pharma in 2020 (search summary only).

drugs.ai_role_en: AbCellera says ABCL635, an antibody against NK3R, is its first internally led programme generated using its GPCR and ion channel antibody-discovery technologies; it makes no AI claim for the drug.
drugs.ai_role_zh: AbCellera 称抗 NK3R 抗体 ABCL635 是其首个利用自有 GPCR 和离子通道抗体发现技术生成的自主项目；公司未就该药作 AI 方面的表述。

source.title: ABCL635 (Internal Program) pipeline page

drugs.note: AbCellera's platform is antibody discovery (screening plus data science), not presented as an AI design platform.

drugs.ai_role_en: AbCellera lists this anti-OX40L antibody as an internal programme with an engineered Fc domain, but neither its pipeline page nor its preclinical-data release says which platform or method discovered it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: AbCellera 将这一抗 OX40L 抗体列为自主项目并说明其 Fc 段经过改造，但其管线页面和临床前数据新闻稿均未说明由何种平台或方法发现。

source.title: ABCL575 (Internal Program) pipeline page

drugs.note: Labelled 'Internal Program' with no partner, which suggests in-house discovery, but that is not stated. The page says AbCellera does not intend to pursue further clinical development of ABCL575.

drugs.ai_role_en: Absci says ABS-201, an anti-prolactin-receptor antibody, was engineered with its generative AI platform and counts it among its AI-designed therapeutics.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Absci 称抗催乳素受体抗体 ABS-201 由其生成式 AI 平台设计，并将其列为公司的 AI 设计药物之一。

source.title: Absci Announces First Participants Dosed in Phase 1/2a HEADLINE Trial of AI-Designed Antibody ABS-201 for Androgenetic Alopecia

drugs.note: Absci's own investor page returned HTTP 403; this is the same release. Absci's case-study page (absci.com/abs-201-case-study) says only that its Integrated Drug Creation platform was applied to design the antibody.

drugs.ai_role_en: Charm says CHM-029, a next-generation menin inhibitor, was discovered using its DragonFold platform, which applies deep learning to model protein-ligand interactions for structure-based design.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Charm 称新一代 menin 抑制剂 CHM-029 是用其 DragonFold 平台发现的，该平台以深度学习模拟蛋白与配体的相互作用，用于基于结构的药物设计。

source.title: CHARM Therapeutics Advances CHM-029, a Next-Generation Menin Inhibitor Designed to Overcome Resistance Mutations, as its First Clinical Candidate for Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML)

drugs.ai_role_en: Compugen says its computational discovery platform identified the target, PVRIG, as a new immune checkpoint; COM701 is the antibody it then made against it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Compugen 称其计算发现平台找到了靶点 PVRIG（一个新的免疫检查点）；COM701 是公司随后针对该靶点开发的抗体。

source.title: COM701/Fc reduced Anti-PVRIG antibody

drugs.note: The computation found the target, not the antibody: no page opened says the antibody itself was computationally designed. One registry name combines COM701 with BMS-986207 (Bristol Myers Squibb's anti-TIGIT) and nivolumab; it is filed here under COM701.

drugs.ai_role_en: Compugen says the target, TIGIT, was discovered by Compugen (and others) in 2009 using its computational discovery platform; COM902 is its antibody against TIGIT.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Compugen 称靶点 TIGIT 是公司（及其他团队）于 2009 年用其计算发现平台发现的；COM902 是公司针对 TIGIT 的抗体。

source.title: COM902 anti-TIGIT antibody

drugs.note: Target discovery only, and Compugen itself says 'and others': TIGIT is a widely pursued target. Two registry names are the COM902 + COM701 combination arms of the COM902 trial NCT04354246; they are filed here under COM902.

drugs.ai_role_en: Compugen says its computational discovery work identified IL-18 binding protein as an immune resistance mechanism in patients; COM503 is the antibody it made to block it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Compugen 称其计算发现工作识别出 IL-18 结合蛋白是患者体内的一种免疫耐药机制；COM503 是公司为阻断该蛋白而开发的抗体。

source.title: Compugen Publishes Paper in Cancer Immunology Research Demonstrating Therapeutic Potential of COM503

drugs.note: Target discovery only. Licensed to Gilead, which calls it GS-0321; Compugen runs the Phase 1 trial.

drugs.ai_role_en: Relay says its Dynamo platform enabled the discovery of zovegalisib: structural and simulation work on PI3Kα revealed a new allosteric site on the mutant protein and supported the design of the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Relay 称其 Dynamo 平台促成了 zovegalisib 的发现：对 PI3Kα 的结构与模拟研究揭示了突变蛋白上一个新的变构位点，并支持了分子设计。

source.title: Relay Therapeutics Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Updates

drugs.note: Physics-based / structure-based computation rather than machine learning alone. Also stated on relaytx.com/pipeline and in Relay's 2022 prospectus supplement ('a novel allosteric site discovered by the Dynamo platform').

drugs.ai_role_en: Relay's filings call RLY-5836 a second, chemically distinct pan-mutant PI3Kα inhibitor it developed itself, but no page opened says the Dynamo platform discovered or designed this molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Relay 的申报文件称 RLY-5836 是公司自行开发的第二个、化学结构不同的泛突变型 PI3Kα 抑制剂，但所打开的页面均未说明该分子由 Dynamo 平台发现或设计。

source.title: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2023

drugs.note: In-house molecule from the same PI3Kα programme as zovegalisib, so a Dynamo origin is likely, but only a third-party database (MedPath, seen as a search summary) says 'designed on the Dynamo platform'. Deprioritised in 2024 in favour of RLY-2608 (search summary, not opened).

drugs.ai_role_en: Relay says it created RLY-8161, which it believes is the first NRAS-selective inhibitor, but the pages opened do not say the Dynamo platform discovered or designed it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Relay 称 RLY-8161 由公司创制，并认为它是首个 NRAS 选择性抑制剂，但所打开的页面未说明它由 Dynamo 平台发现或设计。

source.title: Pipeline

drugs.note: In-house molecule ('We have created...'); the same page and the Q1 2026 release credit Dynamo by name only for zovegalisib and lirafugratinib. Relay's own press release on the trial start (allsci.com copy) returned 403.

drugs.ai_role_en: Regor says RGT-075 was 'discovered and developed by Regor', and that Regor is powered by its rCARD (computer accelerated rational discovery) engine; the release does not spell out what rCARD did for this molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Regor 称 RGT-075 由公司自行发现和开发，并称公司由 rCARD（计算机加速理性发现）引擎驱动；新闻稿未具体说明 rCARD 在该分子上做了什么。

drugs.ai_role_en: Regor presents the sale of RGT-419B to Genentech as validation of its rCARD discovery engine, and says its in-house assets were advanced using that computer accelerated rational discovery platform.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Regor 把 RGT-419B 出售给基因泰克一事称为对其 rCARD 发现引擎的验证，并称其自研项目均借助这一计算机加速理性发现平台推进。

source.title: Regor Releases Phase 2a Topline Results for RGT-075, an Oral Once-daily Small Molecule GLP-1R Agonist, and Begins Phase 2b Study in the US for the Treatment of Obesity

drugs.note: Sold to Genentech / Roche in 2024 ($850M upfront) and now GDC-4198. The attribution is at portfolio level, not a description of how this molecule was designed.

drugs.ai_role_en: No page opened says how RGT-264 was found; Regor's site and the registry record do not describe its discovery.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 所打开的页面均未说明 RGT-264 如何发现；Regor 官网和登记记录都没有描述其发现过程。

source.title: A Phase I Study of RGT-264 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors

drugs.note: Search summaries (not opened) call it an HPK1 inhibitor and list Regor's CTO, who built rCARD, as an inventor. The trial was terminated.

drugs.ai_role_en: No page opened says how RGT-490 was found; Regor's site does not mention it and the registry record only calls it an investigational oral therapy.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 所打开的页面均未说明 RGT-490 如何发现；Regor 官网未提及该药，登记记录仅称其为在研口服药。

source.title: Study of RGT-490 in Patients With PIK3CA-Mutated Advanced Solid Tumors

drugs.note: Described in a search summary as a mutant-selective PIK3CA inhibitor.

drugs.ai_role_en: Aulos says its antibody was designed with the assistance of artificial intelligence using Biolojic Design's AI antibody design platform; Biolojic designed it and Aulos develops it.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Aulos 称其抗体是借助人工智能、用 Biolojic Design 的 AI 抗体设计平台设计的；Biolojic 负责设计，Aulos 负责开发。

source.title: About

drugs.note: The designer is Biolojic Design, not Aulos: Aulos was set up to develop this Biolojic-designed antibody, so 'platform' here means the platform of the sponsor's founding partner. Aulos press releases (Business Wire, 403 on opening; seen as search summaries) say 'Created by Biolojic Design' and call it the first computationally designed antibody to enter a human trial. The package's Biolojic entry lists only BD200, so AU-007 has one record, under Aulos.

drugs.ai_role_en: Biolojic describes BD200 as an AI-designed 'multibody': a bispecific antibody-drug conjugate against Trop2 and Nectin-4 that its computational design platform engineered into one human IgG.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Biolojic 称 BD200 是 AI 设计的“multibody”：一种靶向 Trop2 和 Nectin-4 的双特异性抗体偶联药物，由其计算设计平台设计成单个人源 IgG。

source.title: FDA Clears IND for Biolojic's BD200, the First AI-Designed Multibody ADC to Enter Clinical Trials

drugs.note: Trade article reporting the company's announcement and quoting its CEO. AU-007, Biolojic's other clinical design, is recorded under Aulos.

drugs.ai_role_en: Trade press reports that BenevolentAI's platform identified the Trk receptors as mediators of itch and inflammation in atopic dermatitis, and the company then developed BEN-2293, a topical pan-Trk inhibitor, in-house.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 行业媒体报道称，BenevolentAI 的平台识别出 Trk 受体是特应性皮炎中瘙痒和炎症的介质，公司随后自行开发了外用泛 Trk 抑制剂 BEN-2293。

source.title: BenevolentAI, cruel R&D: AI-enabled drug flunks midphase eczema trial to dent deal plans

drugs.note: Snippet only: the fact that the platform identified the Trk receptors for atopic dermatitis comes from the search summary of the Fierce article (403 on opening); the opened Clinical Trials Arena and Citeline pages do not say how the drug was found. Target identification only. Failed Phase 2a on efficacy in April 2023; discontinued.

drugs.ai_role_en: Bavisant is Johnson & Johnson's former ADHD candidate JNJ-31001074; BenevolentAI's platform picked it out for a new use, daytime sleepiness in Parkinson's disease, which is repurposing, not design.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Bavisant 原为强生的多动症候选药 JNJ-31001074；BenevolentAI 的平台为它挑选了新用途，即帕金森病患者的日间过度嗜睡，这属于老药新用而非设计。

source.title: BenevolentAI poaches drug discovery executive from GlaxoSmithKline

drugs.note: Snippet only: both facts (the JNJ-31001074 identity / J&J origin after a failed ADHD trial, and the AI platform choosing the Parkinson's use) come from search summaries; the Fierce page returned 403 and the opened NHS HRA trial summary names only bavisant and the sponsor. The licence terms were not found.

drugs.ai_role_en: BenevolentAI says PDE10 was identified with the Benevolent Platform as a new target for ulcerative colitis, and its scientists then designed BEN-8744 as a PDE10 inhibitor that stays out of the brain.
drugs.ai_role_zh: BenevolentAI 称 PDE10 是用 Benevolent Platform 识别出的溃疡性结肠炎新靶点，随后公司科学家设计了不进入脑部的 PDE10 抑制剂 BEN-8744。

source.title: BenevolentAI Announces Positive Topline Safety and Pharmacokinetic Data from the Phase Ia Clinical Study of BEN-8744 in Healthy Volunteers

drugs.note: The platform is credited with the target; the molecule design is credited to the company's scientists.

drugs.ai_role_en: No page opened says where OPL-0301, an S1P1 receptor agonist, came from; Valo's statements about in-licensing name only OPL-0401.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 所打开的页面均未说明 S1P1 受体激动剂 OPL-0301 的来源；Valo 关于引进授权的说明只提到 OPL-0401。

source.title: Efficacy and Safety of OPL-0301 Compared to Placebo in Adults With Post-Myocardial Infarction (MI)

drugs.note: Probably in-licensed but unproven: Valo signed a licence with Sanofi on 2021-02-08 (SEC exhibit opened; the schedule of licensed compounds is redacted) and Sanofi had its own S1P1 agonist, SAR247799, but no source ties the two. The only trial was withdrawn before enrolment.

drugs.ai_role_en: Valo says OPL-0401 was in-licensed and 'did not incorporate elements of our platform in discovery or development'; trade press says it was licensed from Sanofi in 2021.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Valo 称 OPL-0401 为引进授权品种，其发现和开发均未用到公司平台；行业媒体称该药于 2021 年从赛诺菲引进。

source.title: Valo Health Announces Topline Results from Phase 2 SPECTRA Study of OPL-0401 in Patients with Diabetic Retinopathy

drugs.note: Sanofi as licensor: pharmaphorum (opened), 'originally licensed from Sanofi in 2021'. ROCK1/2 inhibitor; failed Phase 2 in diabetic retinopathy and development is suspended.

drugs.ai_role_en: PLG0206 is the engineered antimicrobial peptide WLBU2, created by University of Pittsburgh researchers and licensed by the Pitt spin-off Peptilogics; it predates the company's AI platform.
drugs.ai_role_zh: PLG0206 即工程化抗菌肽 WLBU2，由匹兹堡大学研究人员研制，后授权给该校衍生公司 Peptilogics；它早于该公司的 AI 平台。

source.title: Pitt news release on engineered cationic antimicrobial peptides (WLBU2)

drugs.note: The opened release says WLBU2 'was licensed by Pitt spin-off Peptilogics'; that PLG0206 is WLBU2 comes from a PLOS One paper by Peptilogics authors, seen as a search summary. That it predates the AI platform is my reading of the dates, not a company statement. The page title is paraphrased.

drugs.ai_role_en: ProteinQure calls PQ203 a fully AI-designed peptide-drug conjugate: its ProteinStudio platform (molecular simulation plus its own AI models) designed the sortilin-binding peptide that carries the toxin.
drugs.ai_role_zh: ProteinQure 称 PQ203 是完全由 AI 设计的多肽偶联药物：其 ProteinStudio 平台（分子模拟加自研 AI 模型）设计了携带毒素、与 sortilin 结合的多肽。

source.title: ProteinQure home page

drugs.note: The home page states 'fully AI-designed peptide-drug conjugate' and names PQ203 as the lead programme; the sortilin / MMAE detail is from the company's press release as reported by Targeted Oncology (opened).

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion says this MALT1 inhibitor, inherited from Exscientia, was designed with physics-based predictive modelling (molecular dynamics) and AI-powered hotspot analysis, with 344 novel compounds synthesized from hit to lead candidate in 15 months.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 表示，这款承自 Exscientia 的 MALT1 抑制剂是用基于物理的预测建模（分子动力学）和 AI 热点分析设计的，从苗头化合物到候选药物共合成 344 个新化合物，用时 15 个月。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: Registry still uses the Exscientia code EXS73565; GEN (2023) also says it was one of four programmes 'designed using Exscientia's AI platform'. The EXS73565 = REC-3565 link rests on the matching target, indication and sponsor (the 10-K does not print the old code).

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion says this reversible, brain-penetrant LSD1 inhibitor, which originated at Exscientia, was designed with its AI-driven multi-parameter optimisation, with 414 novel candidates synthesized to reach the lead in 22 months.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 表示，这款源自 Exscientia 的可逆、可入脑 LSD1 抑制剂是用其 AI 驱动的多参数优化设计的，共合成 414 个新候选分子，用时 22 个月得到先导候选药物。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: The registry record (NCT07517198) itself lists REC-4539 as another name of EXS74539. Paused in May 2025, then restarted.

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion says this CDK7 inhibitor, inherited from Exscientia, was 'designed entirely using our AI-led platform' (generative AI and active learning), with 136 novel compounds synthesized and a lead chosen in under 11 months.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 表示，这款承自 Exscientia 的 CDK7 抑制剂“完全由我们的 AI 主导平台设计”（生成式 AI 与主动学习），共合成 136 个新化合物，不到 11 个月选定先导分子。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: Developed by Exscientia in partnership with GT Apeiron (hence the GTA prefix); a search summary, not an opened page, says Exscientia bought out GT Apeiron's share in July 2024.

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion says its Recursion OS found the target (RBM39 loss mimics CDK12 loss in its phenomics maps) and its phenomics-based platform guided the chemistry, with 204 candidates synthesized, from target identification to IND-enabling studies in 18 months.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 表示，其 Recursion OS 找到了靶点（表型组图谱显示 RBM39 缺失可模拟 CDK12 缺失），并由表型组平台指导化学优化，共合成 204 个候选分子，从靶点确认到 IND 申报前研究用时 18 个月。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.ai_role_en: An existing HDAC inhibitor that Recursion in-licensed from the Ohio State Innovation Foundation in December 2018; Recursion's phenotypic screening platform picked it out for neurofibromatosis type 2, so the AI chose the use, not the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是一款已有的 HDAC 抑制剂，Recursion 于 2018 年 12 月从俄亥俄州立大学创新基金会引进；Recursion 的表型筛选平台为它选定了 2 型神经纤维瘤病这一新用途，AI 选的是适应症而不是分子。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: Repurposing. The Phase 2/3 trial (NCT05130866) was terminated.

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion says REC-3964 is a new chemical entity, its first to reach the clinic, identified with its AI-driven (machine-learning-aided) phenotypic screening platform in human cells as an inhibitor of C. difficile toxin B.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 表示 REC-3964 是一个新化学实体，也是其首个进入临床的新化学实体，由其 AI 驱动（机器学习辅助）的人细胞表型筛选平台发现，可抑制艰难梭菌毒素 B。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: The Phase 2 trial (NCT06536465) was terminated.

drugs.ai_role_en: A known clinical-stage MEK1/2 inhibitor (formerly Takeda's TAK-733) that Recursion in-licensed from Takeda; Recursion's phenotypic screening platform identified it as a potential treatment for familial adenomatous polyposis, so the AI chose the use, not the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是一款已知的临床阶段 MEK1/2 抑制剂（原为武田的 TAK-733），由 Recursion 从武田引进；Recursion 的表型筛选平台发现它可能用于治疗家族性腺瘤性息肉病，AI 选的是适应症而不是分子。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: Repurposing. Recursion's 2025 shareholder letter calls the FAP result its first AI-enabled clinical proof of concept (search summary only): the claim is about the platform-derived biology, not the molecule.

drugs.ai_role_en: Recursion calls REC-7735 its 'AI-designed' PI3Kα H1047R inhibitor, 'delivered in 10 months and 242 compounds from first novel hit through Recursion's AI-native design platform'.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Recursion 称 REC-7735 是其“AI 设计”的 PI3Kα H1047R 抑制剂，“从首个新苗头化合物起，经 Recursion 的 AI 原生设计平台，用 10 个月、242 个化合物完成”。

source.publisher: Recursion Pharmaceuticals (press release, via Finviz / GlobeNewswire)
source.title: Recursion Reports Second Quarter Financial Results; Genentech Options First Neuroscience Target into Early Discovery Program

drugs.note: Press release of 2026-08-05, read on a syndicated copy because ir.recursion.com refused the request.

drugs.ai_role_en: A previously known compound whose patents for this use Recursion licenses exclusively from the University of Utah Research Foundation; Recursion says the earliest version of its phenotypic platform discovered its use in cerebral cavernous malformation, so the AI chose the use, not the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是一款此前已知的化合物，Recursion 从犹他大学研究基金会独家获得其该用途专利的许可；Recursion 表示，其表型平台的最早版本发现了它在脑海绵状血管畸形中的用途，AI 选的是适应症而不是分子。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: Repurposing. That REC-994 is tempol is widely reported but was not confirmed on the page opened. Recursion's wording is that REC-994 'was discovered using' its platform, which a reader could mistake for design.

drugs.ai_role_en: An apelin receptor agonist whose patents BioAge exclusively in-licensed from Amgen; BioAge says its analysis of human ageing cohorts pointed to the apelin pathway, so the platform chose the target and use, not the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是一款 apelin 受体激动剂，其专利由 BioAge 从安进独家引进；BioAge 表示，其对人类衰老队列的分析指向了 apelin 通路，平台选的是靶点和用途，而不是分子。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: BioAge's former flagship; development terminated in January 2025 after liver enzyme elevations in the Phase 2 obesity trial.

drugs.ai_role_en: A clinical-stage HIF-PH inhibitor (Taisho's TS-143) that BioAge licensed worldwide from Taisho in April 2020; the release says the HIF pathway is linked to healthspan in BioAge's human ageing data but does not say the platform found the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是一款临床阶段的 HIF-PH 抑制剂（大正制药的 TS-143），BioAge 于 2020 年 4 月从大正获得全球许可；新闻稿称 HIF 通路在 BioAge 的人类衰老数据中与健康寿命相关，但没有说该分子是平台发现的。

source.title: BioAge Signs Exclusive License Agreement with Taisho to Develop and Commercialize Taisho's Phase 1 HIF-PH Inhibitor to Treat Aging

drugs.note: Both Phase 2 trials were withdrawn; no longer in BioAge's filings.

drugs.ai_role_en: Asapiprant (S-555739), a DP1 receptor antagonist discovered by Shionogi for allergic rhinitis and licensed to BioAge in January 2021 as a drug repositioning; Shionogi says BioAge's AI-driven analysis of human omics data identified the DP1 target, not the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 即 asapiprant（S-555739），是盐野义为过敏性鼻炎发现的 DP1 受体拮抗剂，2021 年 1 月以“老药新用”方式授权给 BioAge；盐野义称 BioAge 的 AI 人类组学数据分析找到的是 DP1 这个靶点，而不是分子。

source.title: Shionogi and BioAge conclude a license agreement aimed at treating COVID-19

drugs.note: Repurposing. The COVID-19 trial was terminated.

drugs.ai_role_en: BioAge says its human ageing cohort data pointed to NLRP3 as the target, and that BGE-102 itself was discovered by screening a HitGen DNA-encoded chemical library, with the binding site worked out with the University of Bonn; the filing does not credit AI or machine learning with designing the molecule.
drugs.ai_role_zh: BioAge 表示，其人类衰老队列数据指向 NLRP3 这一靶点；BGE-102 本身则是通过筛选成都先导（HitGen）的 DNA 编码化合物库发现的，结合位点是与波恩大学合作确定的；公告文件没有说该分子由 AI 或机器学习设计。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: Borderline between 'platform' and 'partner': the target comes from BioAge's data platform, the molecule from a conventional DNA-encoded library screen with HitGen (one NLRP3 patent family is co-owned with HitGen). An internally discovered drug, but not an AI-designed one.

drugs.ai_role_en: Structure says 'aleniglipron was designed through our internal structure-based drug discovery platform'; the platform is structure-based computation, not specifically machine learning.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Structure 表示“aleniglipron 是通过我们内部的基于结构的药物发现平台设计的”；该平台是基于结构的计算方法，并非专指机器学习。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.ai_role_en: Structure says its oral amylin receptor agonist programme takes a structure-based drug discovery approach 'in collaboration with Schrödinger'; Structure selected ACCG-2671 as the lead in December 2024 and keeps full product rights.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Structure 表示，其口服胰淀素受体激动剂项目是“与薛定谔（Schrödinger）合作”采用基于结构的药物发现方法；Structure 于 2024 年 12 月选定 ACCG-2671 为先导分子，并保留全部产品权利。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: Partner is Schrödinger (a co-founder of Structure). Could equally be read as 'platform': the drug is wholly owned through the subsidiary Aconcagua Bio.

drugs.ai_role_en: Frontier says 'FMC-376 was discovered by applying the Frontier Platform', its chemoproteomics engine that uses covalent chemistry and machine learning, and calls it the first candidate 'born from' the platform to be dosed in a patient.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Frontier 表示“FMC-376 是应用 Frontier 平台发现的”，该平台是其结合共价化学和机器学习的化学蛋白质组学引擎；公司称它是首个“诞生于”该平台并进入人体给药的候选药物。

source.title: Frontier Medicines Announces Oversubscribed $80 Million Series C Financing to Support Progress of Clinical-Stage Pipeline

drugs.note: Also a combination agent in the FMC-242 trial NCT07944092.

drugs.ai_role_en: Frontier's chief executive says FMC-242 'was discovered in just two years' by its scientists 'applying our industry-leading covalent drug platform powered by chemoproteomics and AI'.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Frontier 首席执行官表示，FMC-242 是其科学家“应用我们由化学蛋白质组学和 AI 驱动的共价药物平台”，“仅用两年就发现的”。

source.title: Frontier Medicines Announces Third Precision Oncology Development Candidate

drugs.ai_role_en: Totus says the TOS-358 programme was discovered with its Totus Accel platform, which tracks drug binding in cells with molecular tags and combines this with machine learning, reaching an IND filing 18 months after discovery.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Totus 表示，TOS-358 项目是用其 Totus Accel 平台发现的，该平台用分子标签追踪细胞内的药物结合，并结合机器学习，发现后 18 个月即提交 IND。

source.title: Totus Medicines Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1 Trial of TOS-358 for the Treatment Of Select Solid Tumors

drugs.note: The release describes the platform next to the drug rather than stating in one sentence that the platform designed the molecule; it speaks of 'machine learning', not AI.

drugs.ai_role_en: An A2A receptor antagonist co-invented and developed by Exscientia with Evotec; Exscientia announced it as its first AI-designed immuno-oncology drug to enter trials, with Exscientia's platform doing the design and Evotec providing biology and chemistry.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 这是 Exscientia 与 Evotec 共同发明和开发的 A2A 受体拮抗剂；Exscientia 称它是其首个进入临床的 AI 设计免疫肿瘤药物，由 Exscientia 的平台负责设计，Evotec 提供生物学和化学能力。

source.title: Pipeline Pruning: Exscientia Cuts Programs to Sharpen Precision Oncology Focus

drugs.note: Opened pages (GEN; Evotec's 14 June 2022 release at https://www.evotec.com/news/evotecs-partner-exscientia-reports-topline-data-from-exs-21546-phase-1a-study) confirm the co-invention with Evotec and the discontinuation. The 'AI-designed' wording and the split of roles come only from search summaries of Exscientia's Business Wire releases (2021-04-08, 2022-06-14), which refused to open. Internal development ended in October 2023; the Phase 1/2 trial was terminated.

drugs.ai_role_en: Schrödinger says it used its physics-based computational platform to identify multiple novel series of MALT1 inhibitors and selected SGR-1505 as the development candidate in under two years.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 薛定谔（Schrödinger）表示，公司利用其基于物理的计算平台找到多个新的 MALT1 抑制剂系列，并在不到两年内选定 SGR-1505 为开发候选药物。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: Physics-based computation, not specifically machine learning.

drugs.ai_role_en: Schrödinger says that 'using our computational platform, we identified multiple tight-binding, selective, and novel CDC7 inhibitor series, and selected SGR-2921 as our development candidate'.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 薛定谔（Schrödinger）表示：“利用我们的计算平台，我们找到了多个结合紧密、选择性高的新型 CDC7 抑制剂系列，并选定 SGR-2921 为开发候选药物。”

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

drugs.note: Clinical development discontinued in August 2025 after two deaths in AML patients in which the drug was considered a contributing factor (FY2025 10-K).

drugs.ai_role_en: Schrödinger says it identified a number of tight-binding, selective Wee1/Myt1 inhibitor series using its computational platform and selected SGR-3515 as the development candidate.
drugs.ai_role_zh: 薛定谔（Schrödinger）表示，公司利用其计算平台找到多个结合紧密、选择性高的 Wee1/Myt1 抑制剂系列，并选定 SGR-3515 为开发候选药物。

source.title: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025

drugs.note: Physics-based computation, not specifically machine learning.

drugs.ai_role_en: Verge says its AI-powered CONVERGE platform, working on human ALS tissue data, discovered the target (PIKfyve), and its chief executive calls the compound 'entirely discovered and developed internally on our platform'.
drugs.ai_role_zh: Verge 表示，其基于人类 ALS 组织数据的 AI 平台 CONVERGE 发现了靶点（PIKfyve），首席执行官称该化合物“完全是在我们的平台上内部发现和开发的”。

source.title: Verge Genomics Initiates First-In-Human Dosing in Phase 1 Trial of VRG50635, a Novel Therapeutic for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis

glossary.def_en: Human trials run in stages. Phase 1 tests safety in a few people; Phase 2 is the first real test of whether the drug works, and where most fail; Phase 3 confirms it in hundreds or thousands before approval. "Phase 1/2" combines two stages in one trial.
glossary.def_zh: 人体试验分阶段进行。一期在少数人身上测试安全性；二期首次真正检验药物是否有效，多数药物在此失败；三期在数百至数千人中确证疗效，之后才能申请上市。“1/2 期”指一项试验合并两个阶段。

glossary.def_en: The date the sponsor expects to have collected the data for the trial's main question. Results usually follow within months. It is the sponsor's own estimate and often slips.
glossary.def_zh: 申办方预计收齐试验主要问题所需数据的日期，结果通常在其后数月内公布。这是申办方自己的估计，经常推迟。

glossary.def_en: Patients are assigned by chance to the drug or to a comparison (placebo or standard care). Without this, an apparent benefit may be chance or patient selection.
glossary.def_zh: 患者被随机分配到试验药物组或对照组（安慰剂或标准治疗）。没有随机对照，看到的疗效可能只是偶然或选人造成的。

glossary.def_en: Recruiting: enrolling patients. Active, not recruiting: enrolment closed, patients still being followed. Completed: finished, which does not mean it succeeded. Terminated, withdrawn or suspended: stopped early.
glossary.def_zh: 招募中：正在入组。进行中但不再招募：入组结束，仍在随访。已完成：试验结束，但不代表成功。终止、撤回或暂停：提前停止。

glossary.def_en: A trial the sponsor ended, withdrew or paused before completion. The reason shown is the sponsor's own wording in the registry.
glossary.def_zh: 申办方在完成前终止、撤回或暂停的试验。所示原因为申办方在登记库中的原话。

glossary.def_en: Cash the drugmaker pays when the deal is signed. It is the only part of a deal's value that is certain.
glossary.def_zh: 药企在签约时支付的现金，是交易金额中唯一确定的部分。

glossary.def_en: The "up to" figure in a deal announcement: upfront plus every milestone payment if all the drugs succeed. Most of it is rarely paid.
glossary.def_zh: 交易公告中的“最高可达”金额：首付款加上所有药物都成功时的全部里程碑付款。其中大部分很少真正支付。

glossary.def_en: 0 to 3: how much an item shows the science works. 0 is a claim or money only; 3 needs a randomised human trial result or a regulator's decision. Funding always scores 0.
glossary.def_zh: 0 到 3 分：该条目在多大程度上说明科学有效。0 分只是说法或资金；3 分需要随机人体试验结果或监管决定。融资恒为 0 分。

glossary.def_en: 0 to 3: how much money is moving. 2 means it changes estimates or deal comparisons for a listed company; 3 means it is likely to move a share price or sector spending. It is a description, not a recommendation.
glossary.def_zh: 0 到 3 分：资金变动的程度。2 分表示会改变某上市公司的预期或交易参照；3 分表示可能推动股价或行业支出。这是描述，不是建议。

glossary.def_en: A company touched indirectly: a supplier of computing power or lab tools, a research contractor, or the listed parent of a private company.
glossary.def_zh: 间接受影响的公司：算力或实验室工具供应商、研究外包商，或未上市公司的上市母公司。

glossary.def_en: A company that describes its drug-discovery platform as AI or machine learning. Judged by company, not by molecule; companies using physics-based computation are listed separately as contested.
glossary.def_zh: 自称其药物发现平台由 AI 或机器学习驱动的公司。按公司而非分子判断；以物理计算为主的公司单列为“有争议”。

glossary.def_en: Share price divided by the last twelve months' earnings per share. Not shown for loss-making companies, which includes most drug developers.
glossary.def_zh: 股价除以过去十二个月的每股收益。亏损公司不显示，大多数药物研发公司属于此类。

glossary.def_en: The lowest and highest closing prices of the past year; the marker shows where the latest price sits between them.
glossary.def_zh: 过去一年收盘价的最低与最高值；标记显示最新价格在两者之间的位置。

glossary.def_en: Cash and investments divided by the recent quarterly cash burn: roughly how long a loss-making company can fund itself without raising money.
glossary.def_zh: 现金及投资除以近期的季度现金消耗：亏损公司在不融资的情况下大约还能维持多久。

glossary.def_en: Where the company says the drug came from. Own platform: found or designed by its own discovery platform. With a partner: the platform did part of the work. Bought in or repurposed: licensed from someone else, or an existing compound picked for a new use. Not stated: the company does not say. Only "own platform" drugs of AI drug companies are in the headline numbers.
glossary.def_zh: 公司所说的药物出处。自有平台：由其自有发现平台发现或设计。与合作方共同：平台承担了部分工作。外购或老药新用：从他处授权引进，或为已有化合物找到新用途。未说明：公司没有说明。只有 AI 制药公司的“自有平台”药物计入主要数字。

approvals.text_en: FDA approval for previously treated bile-duct cancer with an FGFR2 rearrangement; the response rate was 46%. Discovered by Relay Therapeutics, licensed to Elevar in December 2024. Relay is in the contested tier: its platform is computer simulation of protein motion, and whether that counts as AI is disputed.
approvals.text_zh: FDA 批准用于既往接受过治疗、携带 FGFR2 重排的胆管癌，客观缓解率为 46%。由 Relay Therapeutics 发现，2024 年 12 月授权给 Elevar。Relay 属于“有争议”一类：其平台是蛋白质运动的计算机模拟，是否算 AI 存在分歧。

longevity.state_en: None exists. A July 2026 Reagan-Udall / FDA meeting summary records no ageing indication, no validated ageing biomarker and no accepted endpoint.

longevity.title_en: Loyal LOY-002: a lifespan drug for senior dogs
longevity.state_en: FDA has accepted the efficacy-expectation and safety sections; the manufacturing section is outstanding. Not approved, and the STAY study has no efficacy readout yet.

longevity.signal_en: Conditional approval, then a positive STAY lifespan readout: the first lifespan-extension approval in any species.
longevity.signal_zh: 获得有条件批准，随后 STAY 研究读出延寿阳性结果：这将是任何物种中首个延寿药物获批。

longevity.title_zh: TAME：二甲双胍对抗衰老相关疾病
longevity.state_en: Still not fully funded about a decade after it was designed; no results.
longevity.state_zh: 设计完成约十年后仍未筹足经费，没有结果。
longevity.signal_en: Full funding and first enrolment; its composite endpoint is the template for an ageing indication.
longevity.signal_zh: 经费到位并开始入组；其复合终点是衰老适应症的范本。

longevity.state_en: Twenty finalist teams named in August 2026; one-year trials run to 2029 and the prize is awarded in 2030. It measures muscle, cognition and immune function, not lifespan.
longevity.state_zh: 2026 年 8 月公布 20 支决赛队伍；为期一年的试验持续到 2029 年，2030 年颁奖。衡量的是肌肉、认知和免疫功能，而不是寿命。
longevity.signal_en: A finalist restores function by 10 years or more in a controlled trial that others replicate.
longevity.signal_zh: 某支决赛队伍在对照试验中使功能恢复 10 年以上，并被他人重复验证。

longevity.title_en: Partial reprogramming in humans (Life Biosciences ER-100)
longevity.title_zh: 人体部分重编程（Life Biosciences ER-100）
longevity.state_en: IND cleared in January 2026 and the first participant dosed in June 2026, ten years after the founding mouse paper. A safety study in eye disease only.
longevity.state_zh: 2026 年 1 月获得 IND 许可，6 月首例受试者给药，距奠基性小鼠论文已十年。目前只是眼病领域的安全性研究。
longevity.signal_en: Efficacy on vision in a controlled trial.
longevity.signal_zh: 在对照试验中显示出改善视力的疗效。

longevity.state_en: Phase 1 safety trial running since December 2025.
longevity.state_zh: 一期安全性试验自 2025 年 12 月起进行。
longevity.signal_en: A Phase 2 efficacy result in a named disease.
longevity.signal_zh: 在明确疾病中取得二期疗效结果。

longevity.title_zh: 衰老细胞清除疗法：Unity Biotechnology
longevity.state_en: UBX0101 showed no benefit over placebo in Phase 2 (2020); UBX1325 missed in Phase 2b and the company laid off all staff in May 2025.
longevity.state_zh: UBX0101 二期试验未优于安慰剂（2020 年）；UBX1325 在 2b 期未达终点，公司于 2025 年 5 月裁撤全部员工。
longevity.signal_en: A reminder: its valuation rested on mouse data. A different senolytic passing a randomised human trial would reopen the field.
longevity.signal_zh: 前车之鉴：其估值建立在小鼠数据之上。若有另一种同类疗法通过随机人体试验，这一方向才会重启。
